Morocco 2026 FIFA World Cup bid
The Morocco 2026 FIFA World Cup bid is Morocco's bid to host the 2026 FIFA World Cup. It is competing with the North America 2026 FIFA World Cup bid, a joint bid between Canada, Mexico and the United States for hosting rights. On 11 August 2017, the Royal Moroccan Football Federation announced that it would submit a bid for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
